images.title: Square, cube and root
images.purpose: A visual summary of three ideas: a square is an area, a cube is a volume, and a root undoes the power.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three small panels in one row, evenly spaced, each with one figure and one short label under it.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 3 items in one horizontal row. Item 1: a 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal squares filled teal (#0072B2), titled square, with 3² = 9 under it. Item 2: a cube of edge 2 in flat oblique view made of 8 equal unit cubes filled amber (#E69F00), titled cube, with 2³ = 8 under it. Item 3: a 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal squares in white with a dark outline, its bottom side drawn thick in reddish purple (#CC79A7), titled root, with √9 = 3 under it. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Squares are areas, cubes are volumes, and roots take us back to the side.

image_decisions.why: A three item summary gathers the chapter's main ideas in one calm picture for the recap.
